investment_theses.thesis: AMD outperforms NVIDIA through end of 2026 as data center share gains accelerate and AI capex shifts toward open-source alternatives; express via AMD calls or AMD/NVDA ratio plays.
supporting_signals: CNBC: AMD data center revenue 'nearly doubled' in latest quarter, beating expectations
Hacker News: 'Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too' — signal of competitive open-source AI models reducing NVIDIA dependency
AMD historical pattern of share gains during platform transitions (Zen, EPYC adoption curves)
investment_theses.counter_view: NVIDIA's software moat (CUDA ecosystem) and established enterprise relationships far exceed AMD's; margin compression and slower Instinct ramp could disappoint by 2026 midyear.
investment_theses.expression: Long AMD calls (6-month tenor, ATM or slightly OTM) or long AMD/NVDA call spread; alternatively, short NVDA vs. long AMD on equal notional basis.

investment_theses.thesis: US equity market (SPY/QQQ) rallies >10% post-midterm announcement (November 4–December 31, 2026) if Democrats retain Senate control, as regulatory clarity on AI/crypto/defense spending reduces uncertainty premium.
supporting_signals: CNBC: 'Midterms historically precede a strong year for the S&P 500'; Democratic control favors tech-friendly, pro-capex regulatory environment
CoinDesk midterm election coverage shows prediction market favorability toward Democrats in key races
Defense spending concerns (Ukraine aid, Iran strikes per BBC coverage) alleviate under Democratic Congress; tech antitrust pressures ease relative to Republican scenario
investment_theses.counter_view: Market already pricing in Democratic midterm victory; actual outcome may be priced in; recession risk in late 2026 could override midterm tailwind.
investment_theses.expression: Long SPY or QQQ call spreads (Nov 4–Dec 31 expiry); or long equal-weight tech ETF (RSP) if seeking to isolate mega-cap rotation away from AI concentration risk.

investment_theses.thesis: BTC consolidates 60–70k range through midterms (Nov 3, 2026), then breaks higher to 75–85k by year-end as post-election pro-crypto regulatory clarity drives institutional FOMO and ETF inflows.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: 'What voters said about their views on crypto' — voter appetite for crypto policy clarity is salient
Prediction market favorability toward pro-crypto Democratic House members (Cointelegraph coverage)
Binance $6.3B hack (BBC) accelerates institutional migration to regulated venues (Coinbase, Kraken, OKX); security event historically triggers consolidation before upside breakout
investment_theses.counter_view: BTC remains correlated to tech earnings cycle and Fed policy; macro recession or rate hike surprise in 2H 2026 could cap upside; regulatory clarity may not materialize before year-end.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC perpetual futures (2–4 week rolling position through midterms, exit into strength); or buy BTC calls (Dec 2026 expiry, 70k strike) and sell calls (85k strike) for a defined-risk bull call spread.

investment_theses.thesis: CrowdStrike (CRWD) outperforms broad tech market (QQQ) by 20%+ through end of 2026 as enterprise AI agent governance/safety becomes critical capex priority; Apple 10-K warnings validate market need.
supporting_signals: CNBC: CrowdStrike CEO explicitly framed AI agent 'kill switch' as 'massive market opportunity' to Jim Cramer
Apple 10-K filing warns of AI agents exceeding permissions and resisting instructions — validates CrowdStrike's value prop for enterprises managing rogue agents
Enterprise security capex accelerating as AI adoption in workflows becomes real; Postman auto-installing AI plugins (Hacker News) triggers enterprise governance concerns
investment_theses.counter_view: CRWD valuation already elevated (high multiple); competition from Microsoft Defender and open-source solutions intensifies; enterprise AI agent adoption slower than predicted.
investment_theses.expression: Long CRWD call spreads (6-month tenor, buy ATM, sell 20% OTM) or long CRWD vs. short QQQ on equal beta-adjusted notional to isolate outperformance thesis.

investment_theses.thesis: DXY (US Dollar Index) softens 2–3% through end of 2026 if midterm elections deliver Democratic sweep, as Fed pressure mounts to cut rates into 2027 and crypto regulatory thaw reduces US regulatory premium.
supporting_signals: CNBC midterm analysis: Democratic control likely favors lower rates and softer fiscal consolidation, pressuring DXY
CoinDesk: crypto regulatory clarity under Democratic leadership reduces 'flight to USD safety' premium currently priced in
Binance hack (BBC) may accelerate stablecoin governance frameworks, reducing USD-as-safe-haven demand in crypto markets; spillover to broader FX flows
investment_theses.counter_view: Fed independence limits political influence on rates; global central banks tightening into 2026 supports DXY; geopolitical risk (Ukraine, Iran per BBC coverage) sustains USD demand.
investment_theses.expression: Short DXY futures (3–6 month contract) or long DXY puts (Nov/Dec 2026 expiry, 105 strike); alternatively, long EURUSD or GBPUSD FX pairs as hedge against DXY strength.
